fact: The BCEAO says the Treasury of Cote d'Ivoire, having met all PI-SPI requirements, regularly makes bulk payments through the platform, which lets Treasuries send salaries, grants and subsidies to any account.

APIF's 2024 report says the government's Programme Filets Sociaux Productifs pays quarterly allowances to rural households by mobile phone into e-money accounts, with 230,000 active beneficiaries and 130,000 new mobile money accounts opened in 2024.
